returned_title: German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP-Core), 1984–2014
justification: An expanded historical version of the German Socio-Economic Panel containing annual household and individual survey data spanning the entire 1990s. Includes information on employment transitions, household finances, income inequality, occupational mobility, and socioeconomic conditions. Particularly suitable for studying how reunification and the introduction of market institutions affected households and workers in East Germany.

returned_title: World Bank – Germany GDP at Purchasing Power Parity
justification: A Germany-specific historical dataset sourced from the World Bank's World Development Indicators and accessible through UNdata. Contains annual GDP estimates adjusted for purchasing power parity, including the 1990s. Useful for evaluating changes in Germany's economic size, comparing economic development internationally, and examining the country's economic position following reunification.

returned_title: German Regional Statistical Database – Regionaldatenbank Deutschland
justification: An official statistical database maintained by Germany's federal and state statistical authorities. Provides geographically detailed indicators covering economic activity, employment, population, businesses, and regional development. Historical regional statistics can support research into economic restructuring, differences between eastern and western federal states, and regional development during the post-reunification period. Availability of 1990s observations depends on the individual statistical series.

returned_title: World Bank – Germany Historical GDP and National Accounts
justification: Provides historical GDP statistics for Germany through the World Bank's World Development Indicators database. Includes observations relevant to the 1990s and supports analysis of Germany's economic expansion, post-reunification adjustments, and long-term development. Particularly useful for constructing economic growth trends and comparing Germany's performance with other economies.

returned_title: Our World in Data – Historical GDP, Maddison Project Database
justification: A historical GDP dataset based on the Maddison Project Database, with Germany-specific observations available for the 1990s. Provides inflation-adjusted, internationally comparable estimates of economic output. Useful for visualizing long-term economic development, examining changes around German reunification, and comparing Germany's economic performance with other countries. Particularly accessible for researchers seeking downloadable time-series data.

returned_title: Eurobarometer Surveys – Public Opinion on the European Union and International Politics (2020–2026)
justification: One of the most relevant sources for studying international politics and organisations across all 27 EU member states listed. Eurobarometer provides survey microdata covering public attitudes toward European integration, EU institutions, foreign policy, international cooperation, democracy, security, and geopolitical challenges. Surveys conducted throughout the 2020s allow comparisons between countries and over time.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 100.2 (2023) – Public Attitudes Toward the European Union
justification: A specific cross-national survey dataset covering all 27 requested EU member states. Fieldwork was conducted in October and November 2023. The dataset supports comparative research on public perceptions of European institutions, European integration, political priorities, and international issues. Particularly useful for analysing differences in political attitudes between Western, Central, Eastern, Northern, and Southern European countries.

returned_title: GESIS Eurobarometer Data Service – Standard, Special and Flash Eurobarometer
justification: Provides access to multiple European Commission and European Parliament survey series. Relevant topics include trust in international organisations, EU enlargement, European foreign policy, international security, defence cooperation, and attitudes toward global challenges. Researchers can select surveys conducted during the 2020s and compare respondents across the 27 requested countries.

returned_title: Public Voting Data of the Council of the European Union (2010–2023)
justification: A dataset recording the voting behaviour of EU member states in public Council votes between 2010 and 2023, including the 2020–2023 period. It is particularly relevant for studying international political negotiations, cooperation between national governments, voting coalitions, disagreements, and institutional decision-making within the European Union. All 27 requested countries can be studied during the relevant years.

returned_title: EU Council Monitor – Voting Behaviour of EU Member States
justification: Developed by the German Institute for International and Security Affairs, this resource provides structured information and interactive analysis of voting patterns in the Council of the European Union. It supports investigations of political alliances, government preferences, consensus, opposition, and institutional cooperation among the 27 EU member states during the 2020s. The underlying data concern publicly recorded Council votes.

returned_title: European Parliament Open Roll-Call Voting Data – OpenRCV
justification: Provides downloadable voting records from the European Parliament, sourced from its official Open Data Portal. The dataset includes roll-call votes from July 2024 onward and identifies individual Members of the European Parliament. It is suitable for analysing voting behaviour, political group cohesion, transnational party alliances, and national differences in European policymaking across all 27 requested countries.

returned_title: European Parliament Voting Records – EP Votes
justification: Offers structured European Parliament roll-call voting data derived from official parliamentary records. Researchers can investigate how representatives from Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Germany, and the other requested EU countries vote on European legislation and international political issues. Particularly useful for studying foreign policy positions, parliamentary cooperation, ideological divisions, and the behaviour of European political groups during the 2020s.

returned_title: 2024 European Parliament Election Results – Official Downloadable Datasets
justification: Official European Parliament election datasets covering all 27 requested EU countries. The downloadable data include election results, parliamentary composition, and electoral turnout. They are particularly useful for comparing national political representation, European political party families, voter participation, and the distribution of political influence within the European Parliament following the June 2024 elections.

returned_title: 2024 European Elections – European Parliament Official Results
justification: An authoritative source of country-level electoral results and European Parliament composition. The resource provides information on electoral participation and the representation of political groups across the 27 EU member states. It supports research on European political integration, electoral competition, transnational party organisations, and public participation in EU governance during the 2020s.

returned_title: United Nations General Assembly Voting Data – UN Digital Library
justification: An official United Nations dataset containing country-level voting records on General Assembly resolutions, with historical coverage extending into the 2020s. Researchers can examine how the 27 requested European countries vote on international security, human rights, armed conflicts, development, sovereignty, and global governance. Particularly valuable for identifying diplomatic alignment and disagreements among EU member states at the United Nations.

returned_title: United Nations General Assembly Resolutions: Voting Data and Issue Categories (UNGA-RES)
justification: A research dataset combining United Nations General Assembly voting records with thematic classifications of resolutions. Its coverage extends through September 2022, providing data for the beginning of the 2020s. It enables systematic comparisons of foreign policy preferences, diplomatic cooperation, and international political alignment among the 27 European countries across different international policy areas.

returned_title: United Nations Digital Library – Voting Data Collection
justification: The official United Nations Digital Library provides access to voting records and documentation relating to the General Assembly and Security Council. Researchers can retrieve records from the 2020s and analyse the diplomatic behaviour of the requested European countries. Relevant research topics include international organisations, multilateral diplomacy, international law, security policy, and collective responses to international crises.

returned_title: United Nations Voting Data – UNIndex
justification: Provides structured access to United Nations voting information, including country positions on General Assembly resolutions. The resource references official United Nations voting datasets updated during 2026. It is useful for quantitative analysis of voting similarities, diplomatic coalitions, international policy preferences, and European coordination within the UN system. Country identifiers allow researchers to isolate the 27 requested EU member states.

returned_title: European Union Sanctions Map – EU Restrictive Measures
justification: An EU open-data catalogue entry concerning persons subject to travel restrictions under European Union sanctions. This resource is relevant for studying the EU's collective external action, international sanctions, human rights policy, and responses to geopolitical crises during the 2020s. Because EU restrictive measures are adopted collectively, the information is relevant to all 27 requested member states. The dataset focuses on sanctioned persons rather than individual member-state voting behaviour.

returned_title: EU Sanctions Map – OpenSanctions Structured Dataset
justification: Provides structured, downloadable data derived from EU sanctions information. It supports research on European foreign policy, economic restrictions, international security, diplomatic pressure, and the implementation of collective EU measures. Particularly useful for studying how the European Union acts internationally as a political organisation during the 2020s. The dataset concerns EU-level sanctions rather than separate national sanctions policies.

returned_title: Council of the European Union – Legislative Voting Dataset
justification: An official European open-data catalogue record documenting voting on legislative acts in the Council of the European Union. The dataset is relevant for studying decision-making, international institutional cooperation, and national government positions within the EU. It can help researchers identify historical patterns of consensus and disagreement among the requested countries. The catalogue identifies this particular dataset as discontinued, so it should be treated as a historical resource rather than a comprehensive source of current voting data.

returned_title: European Parliament Members' Lobby Meetings Dataset (2019–2026)
justification: An openly available dataset containing declared meetings involving Members of the European Parliament, with coverage extending from 2019 into 2026. It is useful for examining political influence, interest representation, lobbying organisations, institutional transparency, and relationships between elected representatives and external actors. Researchers can investigate the activities of MEPs representing the 27 requested countries during the 2020s.

returned_title: European Parliament Roll-Call Voting Results – OpenRCV Explorer
justification: Provides an accessible interface to European Parliament roll-call voting records from July 2024 onward. Votes can be examined by parliamentary procedure, voting session, and individual representative. It is useful for analysing international political cooperation, European institutional decision-making, and differences between national delegations. The resource complements downloadable voting datasets by making individual decisions and voting patterns easier to identify.

returned_title: Nations on Record – International Political Indicators and UN Voting Data
justification: Provides open datasets on international political and socioeconomic indicators, including United Nations voting information, military expenditure, democracy indicators, and refugee statistics. Country-level records can be filtered to the 27 requested EU member states. The resource is useful for connecting international political behaviour with domestic conditions, defence commitments, democratic institutions, and geopolitical developments during the 2020s.

returned_title: 2024 European Parliament Election Results – Official European Parliament Dataset
justification: Official election results covering all 27 requested EU countries in 2024. Includes national election results, political party representation, distribution of parliamentary seats, political groups, and voter turnout. Particularly useful for comparing electoral outcomes, political representation, and voting behavior across Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden, and Croatia.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) – Round 10 (2020–2022) and Round 11 (2023–2024)
justification: Cross-national survey datasets covering political attitudes, institutional trust, satisfaction with democracy, political participation, voting behavior, political ideology, and attitudes toward government. Rounds 10 and 11 provide observations collected during the 2020s. Researchers can select participating European countries and compare individual-level political attitudes across different survey waves. Not every requested country participates in every round.

returned_title: Eurobarometer Data Service – Political Attitudes and Public Opinion in the European Union
justification: Extensive collection of European public opinion surveys, including surveys conducted throughout the 2020s. Covers all 27 requested EU member states through relevant survey waves. Political variables include trust in national governments, confidence in political institutions, perceptions of democracy, EU integration, political priorities, and attitudes toward European policies. Particularly useful for longitudinal and cross-country comparisons of political opinion.

returned_title: Eurobarometer – European Parliament Autumn 2025 Survey
justification: European Parliament public opinion survey covering political priorities and attitudes across the 27 EU member states. Addresses perceptions of EU institutions, citizens' policy priorities, democratic concerns, disinformation, freedom of speech, security, and economic challenges. Provides a recent 2020s perspective on political attitudes in the requested countries.

returned_title: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Dataset – Version 15 (2025)
justification: International country-year dataset containing hundreds of indicators of democracy, political institutions, civil liberties, electoral integrity, political participation, judicial independence, freedom of expression, and government accountability. Includes all 27 requested European countries and observations from the 2020s. Particularly suitable for quantitative comparisons of democratic quality and political developments over time.

returned_title: V-Dem Dataset Archive – Historical and Recent Democracy Indicators
justification: Archive of V-Dem country-year datasets covering political institutions, democratic governance, electoral democracy, liberal democracy, participatory democracy, and political freedoms. Enables researchers to obtain specific dataset versions and compare political developments during the 2020s across the 27 requested EU countries.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES) – 2024 European Political Party Positions
justification: Expert survey dataset measuring political party positions across European countries, including EU member states. The 2024 wave provides information about party ideology, left-right positioning, European integration, economic policies, immigration, and social issues. Especially relevant for comparing party competition and ideological polarization across the 27 requested countries during the 2020s.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – European Party Position Trend Dataset (1999–2024)
justification: Longitudinal dataset of expert assessments of European political party positions, incorporating the 2024 survey wave. Supports analysis of political polarization, Euroscepticism, ideological shifts, and party competition. Researchers can examine how political party positions changed entering and during the 2020s across European countries.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Dataset – Political Party Preferences (2025a)
justification: Comparative dataset containing quantitative analyses of political parties' electoral manifestos. Includes European elections and national elections covered during the 2020s. Provides indicators of political ideology, economic policy preferences, welfare policies, democratic principles, nationalism, environmental policies, and European integration. Particularly useful for studying political party platforms and policy priorities in the requested countries.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Database – Current Political Manifesto Dataset
justification: Research database containing coded political party election manifestos and associated electoral information. Includes national political parties from European democracies and elections held during the 2020s. Suitable for comparing political agendas, ideological positioning, party competition, and changes in policy emphasis across countries and elections.

returned_title: International IDEA – Voter Turnout Database
justification: International electoral participation dataset containing voter turnout statistics for national parliamentary elections, presidential elections, and European Parliament elections. Covers the requested EU member states and includes elections during the 2020s. Provides measures based on registered voters and voting-age populations, making it useful for comparing electoral participation and democratic engagement.

returned_title: ParlGov – Political Parties, Elections, and Cabinets Database
justification: Comparative political database documenting political parties, national elections, government cabinets, and coalition formation in European democracies. Provides electoral results, party information, and government composition, including records relevant to the 2020s. Useful for examining government turnover, coalition politics, party systems, and parliamentary representation across EU countries. The availability of recent observations should be checked for individual countries.

returned_title: Political Parties, Presidents and Governments Database (PPEG)
justification: Cross-national political dataset covering parliamentary elections, presidential elections, political parties, and government cabinets. Its coverage extends into the 2020s, with records through October 2025 in the version described by the project. Relevant variables include election outcomes, political party affiliations, coalition governments, cabinet composition, and ministerial appointments. Supports comparisons of political institutions and government formation in European countries.

returned_title: Representative Democracy Data Archive (REPDEM) – Basic Dataset
justification: Comparative database covering elections, political parties, governments, cabinets, and parliamentary institutions. Includes information about election dates, party vote shares, electoral alliances, cabinet composition, and government formation. Its coverage extends into 2026, making it valuable for studying political developments during the 2020s. Geographic coverage focuses on a defined set of parliamentary democracies rather than necessarily including every requested EU country.

returned_title: Representative Democracy Data Archive – Current Election and Government Datasets
justification: Research datasets containing information on parliamentary elections, political parties, government coalitions, political institutions, and cabinet membership in 33 parliamentary democracies. The current dataset description reports coverage through September 30, 2026. Particularly useful for examining government stability, electoral competition, coalition formation, and political party representation during the 2020s.

returned_title: European Election Studies (EES) – Research Data Collection
justification: GESIS research data collection dedicated to European Election Studies, including datasets associated with the 2024 European Parliament elections. Covers political behavior, electoral preferences, political parties, election campaigns, political attitudes, and European integration. The collection includes research materials such as the 2024 European election party manifesto study. Useful for cross-national analysis of European electoral politics during the 2020s.

returned_title: 2024 European Parliament Election Results – Country-Level Election Database
justification: Official European Parliament election results portal covering the June 2024 elections in all 27 requested countries. Provides country-specific electoral outcomes, political group representation, turnout figures, and parliamentary seat allocations. Particularly suitable for studying differences in party support, electoral participation, and European political representation.

returned_title: 2024 European Parliament Election Results – Ireland Open Data
justification: Official Irish government open-data record covering the 2024 European Parliament election results in Ireland. Useful for analyzing Irish electoral competition, political party performance, candidate outcomes, and representation in the European Parliament. Offers a country-specific complement to the comparative European election datasets.

returned_title: ACLED – Armed Conflict Location & Event Data: Political Violence and Protests in Europe
justification: One of the most relevant datasets for studying conflict, security and peace across all 27 specified EU countries during the 2020s. ACLED provides georeferenced, event-level information on political violence, protests, riots, violence against civilians and other security-related events. European coverage includes events from January 2020 onward. Records contain dates, locations, actors, event classifications and reported fatalities. Particularly useful for comparing political instability, civil unrest and conflict dynamics across European countries.

returned_title: ACLED – Aggregated Political Violence and Demonstration Data
justification: Provides aggregated statistics on political violence, demonstrations, civilian targeting and reported fatalities. Data are available by country and year or month, with additional subnational aggregations for Europe and Central Asia. Suitable for examining trends in political unrest, protest activity and internal security across the specified EU countries throughout the 2020s. Particularly useful for comparative statistical analysis and longitudinal research.

returned_title: Eurostat – Police-Recorded Offences by Offence Category
justification: Official European statistical dataset covering police-recorded criminal offences across all 27 specified EU countries. Includes annual observations from 2008 through 2024, covering the first half of the 2020s. Offence categories include intentional homicide and other forms of criminal activity classified according to the International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes. Useful for comparing domestic security, violent crime and public safety, although differences in national reporting practices must be considered.

returned_title: Eurostat – Intentional Homicide Victims by Victim-Offender Relationship and Sex
justification: Provides annual statistics on intentional homicide victims, disaggregated by sex and victim-offender relationship. Includes observations from 2020 through 2024 for numerous EU countries, although reporting coverage varies. Particularly relevant for studying interpersonal violence, domestic violence, gender-related security risks and physical safety. Supports comparative analysis of lethal violence within European societies.

returned_title: Eurostat – Crime, Violence or Vandalism in the Local Area
justification: Measures the proportion of people reporting crime, violence or vandalism in their residential area. Based on the EU Statistics on Income and Living Conditions survey, this dataset covers the specified EU countries and includes observations during the 2020s. Particularly useful for examining perceived security, neighbourhood safety and differences between objective crime statistics and citizens' experiences of insecurity.

returned_title: Eurostat – Crime, Violence or Vandalism by Degree of Urbanisation
justification: Provides comparative indicators of perceived crime, violence and vandalism across cities, towns, suburbs and rural areas. Covers the EU member states during the 2020s. Useful for investigating geographical inequalities in public safety, urban security challenges and differences in perceived insecurity between urban and rural populations.

returned_title: Eurostat – General Government Expenditure by Function
justification: Provides annual government expenditure data classified by function, including defence and public order and safety. Covers all 27 specified EU countries and includes observations during the 2020s. Public order and safety expenditure can be broken down into categories such as police services, courts, prisons and fire protection. Particularly useful for analysing national security priorities, defence spending, institutional capacity and government responses to security challenges.

returned_title: Eurostat – Regional Crime Statistics
justification: Contains regional statistics on police-recorded criminal offences, including intentional homicide. Provides geographical detail beyond national averages for EU countries with available regional observations during the 2020s. Useful for studying regional disparities in violence, urban security, territorial inequalities and geographical concentrations of criminal activity.

returned_title: Eurostat – Crime and Criminal Justice Statistics
justification: Official statistical collection containing datasets on criminal offences, police personnel, criminal justice institutions, prison populations, prosecution and judicial systems. Includes data reported by EU member states throughout the 2020s. Relevant for evaluating security governance, criminal justice capacity, institutional effectiveness and national differences in responses to crime. Provides access to several complementary datasets suitable for cross-country comparisons.

returned_title: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
justification: Internationally recognised dataset providing annual military expenditure statistics for countries worldwide, including the 27 specified EU member states. The database covers 1949–2025, allowing detailed analysis of military spending during the 2020s. Indicators include expenditure in national currencies, US dollars, constant prices, expenditure per capita and military spending as a percentage of GDP. Particularly relevant for studying European defence policy, military preparedness, security investment and spending changes following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

returned_title: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
justification: Provides information on international transfers of major conventional weapons, including transactions involving European countries during the 2020s. Relevant for investigating arms imports, military exports, European defence cooperation, strategic dependencies and changes in military capabilities. Particularly useful for examining how EU countries have adjusted arms procurement and defence partnerships in response to evolving European security threats.

returned_title: SIPRI Multilateral Peace Operations Database
justification: Contains information on multilateral peace operations conducted since 2000, including United Nations and non-UN missions. Records include mission locations, deployment periods, participating countries, personnel contributions, budgets and fatalities. Relevant for analysing the participation of the specified EU countries in international peacekeeping, conflict prevention and post-conflict stabilisation during the 2020s. Particularly valuable for examining European contributions to international peace and security.

returned_title: SIPRI National Budget Archive
justification: Provides access to national budget documents used to compile SIPRI's military expenditure statistics. The archive includes budgetary sources from 2021 onward and is updated annually. Useful for investigating how European governments allocate financial resources to defence, examining national spending priorities and validating cross-country defence expenditure comparisons.

returned_title: Uppsala Conflict Data Program – Georeferenced Event Dataset
justification: Research dataset documenting organised violence, including state-based conflicts, non-state conflicts and one-sided violence against civilians. Includes georeferenced information on violent events, actors, locations and estimated fatalities. Data covering the 2020s can be used to identify organised violent incidents affecting European countries where such events meet UCDP inclusion criteria. Especially useful for studying armed conflict and lethal organised violence, although coverage of EU countries is more limited than ACLED because UCDP applies stricter definitions of organised violence.

returned_title: Uppsala Conflict Data Program – Historical Georeferenced Event Dataset Releases
justification: Provides archived versions of UCDP's georeferenced conflict event datasets, including releases covering different years of the 2020s. Useful for reproducible research, comparing successive conflict data releases and examining changes in the coding of organised violence. Particularly relevant for historical analysis of security incidents and conflict-related fatalities, subject to the programme's inclusion criteria.

returned_title: Global Terrorism Database – National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism
justification: International database documenting terrorist attacks, including incidents affecting European countries. Contains information on attack dates, locations, methods, targets, perpetrators and casualties. The downloadable historical dataset extends through 2020, making it useful for studying terrorism at the beginning of the decade and establishing historical baselines. It does not provide comprehensive coverage of the subsequent 2020s and should therefore be combined with more recent sources for longitudinal research.

returned_title: Eurostat – Population Reporting Crime, Violence or Vandalism in Their Area by Poverty Status
justification: Official EU Sustainable Development Goal indicator measuring the proportion of people reporting crime, violence or vandalism in their neighbourhood, with breakdowns related to poverty status. Covers the EU member states and includes observations from the 2020s. Directly relevant to SDG 16 on peace, justice and strong institutions. Useful for analysing perceived insecurity, social vulnerability and inequalities in exposure to neighbourhood safety problems.

returned_title: European Parliament Election Study 2024 – Voter Study (EES 2024)
justification: One of the most directly relevant datasets for this query. Conducted in June 2024 following the European Parliament elections, this survey covers all 27 requested EU member states. It includes 25,904 respondents and examines voting behaviour, electoral participation, political preferences, attitudes towards European integration, evaluations of political institutions, and perceptions of democracy. Particularly suitable for comparative research on political behaviour and attitudes across all specified countries.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 100.2 (2023)
justification: A cross-national public opinion dataset collected between October and November 2023. It covers all 27 requested EU member states and provides comparable information on political attitudes, public perceptions of European institutions, trust, and major political and social concerns. Particularly useful for examining differences in political opinions across EU countries during the 2020s.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 101.3 (2024)
justification: A 2024 Eurobarometer dataset covering the 27 EU member states. It provides individual-level survey data relevant to political behaviour and attitudes, including perceptions of European institutions, political priorities, social concerns, and public opinion on European affairs. Its standardized methodology supports cross-country comparisons between all requested countries.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Round 10 (2020–2022)
justification: A major comparative survey examining political and social attitudes across European countries during 2020–2022. Relevant variables include political interest, electoral participation, institutional trust, satisfaction with democracy, political ideology, immigration attitudes, and social values. It includes many of the requested countries, although not all 27 participated. The ESS Data Portal allows researchers to select countries, survey rounds, and variables.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Round 11 (2023–2024)
justification: A more recent wave of the European Social Survey, providing comparative individual-level information on political trust, political participation, satisfaction with democracy, ideological orientations, and social attitudes. Particularly valuable for comparing political attitudes in the early and middle 2020s using ESS Round 10 and Round 11. Coverage varies by participating country, so it does not include every requested country.

returned_title: Standard Eurobarometer 104 – Autumn 2025
justification: A European Commission public opinion survey covering all 27 requested EU member states in autumn 2025. It examines attitudes towards the European Union, confidence in institutions, perceptions of political and economic developments, and citizens' priorities. It is particularly relevant for comparing recent political attitudes across the entire EU. The official survey landing page provides access to results and supporting documentation.

returned_title: European Parliament Eurobarometer – Autumn 2025 Survey (Parlemeter)
justification: A European Parliament survey conducted in November 2025 and published in February 2026. It covers all 27 requested countries and investigates citizens' attitudes towards the European Parliament, European integration, political priorities, and major societal concerns. Particularly suitable for studying public trust, democratic representation, and perceptions of European political institutions.

returned_title: European Parliament Eurobarometer – Spring 2025 Survey
justification: An EU-wide public opinion survey focused on political attitudes towards the European Parliament and the European Union. It covers the requested EU member states and provides information on European political priorities, institutional perceptions, and citizens' expectations. Useful for analyzing contemporary political attitudes and comparing public opinion across countries in 2025.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme – National Identity and Citizenship (ISSP 2023)
justification: An international comparative survey addressing national identity, citizenship, political and social attitudes, satisfaction with democracy, social trust, and populism. The dataset includes several requested countries, such as Croatia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Lithuania, and the Netherlands. It is particularly relevant for examining relationships between national identity, democratic values, citizenship norms, and political attitudes. Country coverage is partial rather than EU-wide.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme – National Identity and Citizenship 2023: Data and Documentation
justification: The official GESIS documentation and data-access page for the ISSP 2023 National Identity and Citizenship module. It provides access to comparative survey data, questionnaires, variable documentation, and methodological information. The survey is especially useful for examining political belonging, democratic satisfaction, citizenship attitudes, national identity, and populist orientations in participating European countries.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 539 – Public Opinion in the EU Regions (2024)
justification: A regional public opinion dataset covering the European Union. It is particularly valuable for studying territorial differences in political attitudes, institutional perceptions, and citizens' evaluations of regional and European developments. Unlike conventional national-level surveys, its regional focus enables comparisons of political attitudes within and between EU member states.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 4023 – Civic Engagement
justification: A Eurobarometer dataset relevant to civic engagement, information consumption, and participation in public life. It includes information about how individuals access news through websites, social networks, messaging applications, and other communication channels. Particularly useful for studying the relationship between civic engagement, political information, and public attitudes during the 2020s. Researchers should verify the specific country coverage and fieldwork dates in the GESIS record.

returned_title: Eurobarometer Data Service – GESIS
justification: The principal research data service for accessing Eurobarometer microdata and documentation. It provides access to Standard, Special, and Flash Eurobarometer surveys, including numerous datasets collected during the 2020s across all 27 requested EU member states. Topics include political trust, European integration, democratic attitudes, political participation, institutional evaluations, and public policy preferences. Particularly useful for constructing longitudinal and cross-national datasets.

returned_title: Eurobarometer Data and Documentation Archive
justification: An official archive providing access to Eurobarometer survey datasets, questionnaires, codebooks, and related documentation. It supports the identification and retrieval of surveys conducted throughout the 2020s. Researchers can use the archive to identify individual-level political attitudes and behaviour variables and compare responses across EU member states and survey waves.

returned_title: European Election Studies – GESIS Data Archive
justification: A specialized archive of European Election Studies covering electoral behaviour, political preferences, party support, political attitudes, and European integration. The 2024 voter study includes all 27 requested EU member states. The archive also contains complementary election research, including party manifesto data, political elite studies, and media studies. Particularly valuable for examining political behaviour in the context of European Parliament elections.

returned_title: European Election Studies – Research Data Catalogue
justification: The GESIS research data catalogue entry for the 2024 European Parliament Election Study Voter Study. It provides a direct route to the study's metadata, documentation, and data-access information. The dataset covers Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden, and Croatia. It is an especially strong source for studying electoral participation and political attitudes across the complete set of requested countries.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study – GLES Tracking 2009–2026, Cumulation
justification: A longitudinal political survey dataset focused on Germany, one of the requested countries. It contains repeated measurements of political attitudes, party preferences, government evaluations, electoral intentions, and perceptions of major political issues. The cumulative dataset includes observations from the 2020s, making it useful for analyzing changes in German political behaviour over time. Although limited to Germany, it provides greater national-level detail than many cross-national surveys.

returned_title: German Politbarometer – Political Opinion and Electoral Attitudes
justification: A collection of German political opinion surveys, including datasets from the 2020s. Topics include voting intentions, political party evaluations, government approval, political trust, economic policy, migration, climate policy, international conflicts, and attitudes towards democracy. Particularly useful for detailed longitudinal research on political preferences and public opinion in Germany. The catalogue provides access to individual studies and cumulative datasets.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 2023 – Standard Public Opinion Survey (ZA8779)
justification: The GESIS dataset landing page for Eurobarometer 100.2, providing detailed geographic coverage, methodology, and documentation. It explicitly identifies all 27 requested EU member states, including Croatia, as participating countries. The survey was conducted in October and November 2023 and is particularly suitable for harmonized cross-national analysis of political attitudes, institutional perceptions, and European public opinion.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Integrated Cross-National Survey Data
justification: The official European Social Survey data portal provides access to harmonized survey datasets spanning multiple rounds, including those conducted during the 2020s. It allows researchers to build customized datasets by selecting specific countries, years, and variables. Particularly useful political variables include voting behaviour, political interest, party identification, political trust, satisfaction with democracy, immigration attitudes, and ideological self-placement. The portal supports comparative analysis across participating countries from the requested list, although coverage varies between rounds.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme – Cross-National Survey Data Catalogue
justification: An official catalogue of internationally comparable social and political survey datasets, including modules conducted during the 2020s. Relevant topics include citizenship, national identity, social inequality, environmental attitudes, and the role of government. Several requested EU member states participate in different modules. Particularly useful for studying political values, citizenship norms, perceptions of government responsibilities, and democratic attitudes alongside demographic characteristics.

returned_title: European Election Study (EES) 2024 – Voter Study
justification: One of the most directly relevant datasets for this query. The 2024 European Election Study surveyed voters in all 27 European Union member states, covering every country requested. It includes political ideology, left-right self-placement, perceptions of political parties, voting behavior, party preferences, political attitudes, and attitudes toward European integration. Particularly suitable for comparing ideological orientations across all 27 countries using data collected during the same election period.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES) 2024 – Political Party Positions in Europe
justification: Provides expert assessments of European political parties' ideological positions during the 2020s. The 2024 wave covers 279 political parties across 31 European countries. Variables include general left-right ideology, economic and social policy positions, populism, democracy, European integration, and other political issues. Particularly valuable for comparing political party ideology across European countries. Unlike voter surveys, this dataset measures the ideological positioning of political parties rather than individual citizens. Country coverage should be checked for the specific wave.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) – Rounds 10, 11 and Subsequent 2020s Data
justification: A major cross-national survey providing individual-level information about political ideology and attitudes across Europe. Relevant waves include Round 10 (2020–2022) and Round 11 (2023–2024). The survey includes left-right political self-placement, political interest, party affiliation, voting behavior, trust in political institutions, immigration attitudes, redistribution preferences, and social values. Particularly useful for examining ideological differences among citizens and changes across the 2020s. Not all 27 requested countries participate in every round.

returned_title: Eurobarometer – Standard and Special Eurobarometer Survey Datasets, 2020s
justification: Provides repeated cross-national public opinion surveys covering all 27 requested EU member states. Relevant surveys from the 2020s contain information about political attitudes, party preferences, European integration, trust in institutions, democracy, and social and economic policy preferences. Selected surveys also include ideological left-right self-placement. Particularly valuable for comparing political attitudes across countries and tracking changes over time. Researchers should check individual survey questionnaires because ideological variables are not included in every wave.

returned_title: Eurobarometer – Left-Right Self-Placement Trend Data
justification: A specialized Eurobarometer resource focused on political ideology measured through respondents' self-placement on a left-right political scale. It identifies surveys containing this ideological measure and supports the identification of comparable variables across countries and years. Useful for researchers specifically interested in political ideology rather than broader political attitudes. The resource includes historical survey references, so researchers must identify the relevant 2020s Eurobarometer waves rather than assume the entire trend series covers the requested period.

returned_title: Harmonized Eurobarometer 2004–2021, Version 3.0.0
justification: A harmonized cross-national dataset combining 35 Standard Eurobarometer surveys conducted between 2004 and 2021. Includes more than 140 variables covering political institutions, European integration, identity, political attitudes, partisanship, and other sociopolitical characteristics. Relevant for investigating ideological and political orientations at the beginning of the 2020s and comparing them with earlier periods. Its temporal coverage ends in 2021, making it a complementary resource rather than a complete dataset for the decade.

returned_title: Joint European Values Study and World Values Survey Dataset 2017–2022
justification: Combines European Values Study and World Values Survey observations collected between 2017 and 2022. Includes questions about political ideology, left-right orientation, democracy, political participation, institutional trust, authoritarian values, religion, and social attitudes. Useful for studying the relationship between ideological identification and broader cultural or political values. The dataset includes observations extending into the early 2020s, although survey years and participating countries vary.

returned_title: European Values Study – Data and Documentation
justification: Provides access to European Values Study datasets, including integrated international datasets and combined European Values Study–World Values Survey resources. Relevant variables cover political orientation, democracy, political participation, social tolerance, religion, economic redistribution, and cultural values. Useful for analyzing ideological differences across European societies and placing early-2020s observations into a longer historical context. Country and year availability must be verified for individual releases.

returned_title: Integrated Values Surveys 1981–2022
justification: A longitudinal cross-national data resource integrating information from the European Values Study and World Values Survey. It provides harmonized indicators of political orientation, democratic values, political trust, institutional preferences, and cultural attitudes. Useful for comparing early-2020s political ideology with earlier decades and identifying long-term ideological transformations. Its coverage extends through 2022, but not every requested European country has observations for the same years.

returned_title: 2024 European Parliament Post-Election Survey in Six Countries
justification: A comparative post-election survey conducted following the 2024 European Parliament elections. Covers six requested countries: Belgium, Germany, Italy, Hungary, the Netherlands, and Poland. Investigates citizens' voting decisions and the meanings attached to electoral participation. Relevant for examining political preferences, electoral behavior, and ideological divisions in these countries. Provides a focused complement to the broader 27-country European Election Study.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – European Political Party Ideology and Policy Positions
justification: The Chapel Hill Expert Survey data portal provides access to individual survey waves and longitudinal information about European political parties. Researchers can use its 2020s observations to investigate the economic left-right dimension, social and cultural ideological positions, European integration, and party-level political polarization. Particularly useful for examining ideological differences between mainstream, radical-right, radical-left, liberal, conservative, and green parties. The availability of particular countries and parties varies by survey wave.

returned_title: European Observatory of Political Trust – Comparative European Dataset
justification: Provides harmonized cross-national indicators of political trust and related institutional and political characteristics across European countries, with coverage extending to 2023. Integrates information originating from major comparative surveys, including Eurobarometer, European Social Survey, European Values Study, and World Values Survey. Useful for examining how ideological divisions relate to trust in government, democratic institutions, and political systems. It is primarily a political-trust dataset rather than a direct measure of left-right ideology.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) – Election Data and Documentation
justification: Provides detailed election-related survey datasets for Germany, including studies conducted during the 2020s. Relevant variables include left-right ideological identification, political attitudes, party evaluations, voting intentions, electoral behavior, and policy preferences. Useful for detailed analysis of political ideology in Germany and for supplementing cross-national European datasets with more extensive country-specific information.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study – Candidate Study, European Election 2024
justification: A candidate-level dataset based on the 2024 European Parliament election in Germany. Data were collected between June and September 2024 and include candidates' political backgrounds, campaign experiences, political issues, views on democracy, and representation. Useful for studying the political attitudes and ideological characteristics of electoral candidates and comparing them with voter-level ideological preferences. Covers Germany rather than all requested countries.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – 1999–2024 Trend File
justification: A longitudinal dataset tracking European political party positions across multiple survey waves, including the 2020s. Provides comparable expert-coded measures of party ideology, economic policy, sociocultural positions, and European integration. Particularly valuable for measuring ideological shifts, party-system polarization, and changes in the positioning of European political parties over time. Researchers can restrict analysis to 2020s observations and the countries of interest, subject to wave-specific coverage.

returned_title: European Election Studies – Comparative Electoral Survey Data Collection
justification: A GESIS research-data collection providing access to European Election Studies datasets and documentation. Relevant survey variables include ideological left-right self-placement, perceived ideological positions of political parties, voting behavior, party preferences, attitudes toward redistribution and immigration, political trust, and European integration. Particularly useful for identifying comparative election datasets suitable for political ideology research. Researchers should select the 2024 study for coverage of all 27 requested EU member states.

returned_title: IAB Establishment Panel (IAB-Betriebspanel), 1993–2019
justification: Highly relevant dataset for studying business management, industrial organisation, and employment practices in Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia during the 1990s. Conducted annually since 1993, the survey covers establishments across industries in western Germany. Variables include employment development, personnel management, business investment, vocational training, wages, working hours, and organisational characteristics. Researchers can examine developments from 1993 to 1999 and compare establishments across the two federal states, subject to regional identification and data-access restrictions. Available through the Research Data Centre of the Institute for Employment Research (IAB).

returned_title: Establishment History Panel (Betriebs-Historik-Panel, BHP), 1975–2019
justification: Particularly useful for examining industrial structure, establishment characteristics, and organisational changes in Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia throughout the 1990s. The dataset contains annual administrative records of establishments with employees covered by German social security. Variables include industrial classification, establishment location, workforce size, occupational structure, employee qualifications, demographic composition, and wages. Its longitudinal structure supports analysis of establishment growth, contraction, and employment restructuring between 1990 and 1999. Regional identifiers enable geographical analysis, subject to access restrictions.

returned_title: Linked Employer-Employee Data of the IAB (LIAB), Cross-Sectional Model, 1993–2023
justification: An important resource for investigating the relationship between business organisation, management practices, and workforce characteristics during the 1990s. The dataset combines information from the IAB Establishment Panel with administrative employment records. It supports research on personnel policies, organisational structures, workforce composition, wages, and employment relationships. Data from 1993 to 1999 can be selected to examine establishments in Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia. Access is restricted and requires an application to the IAB Research Data Centre.

returned_title: Linked Employer-Employee Data of the IAB (LIAB), Longitudinal Model, 1975–2024
justification: Useful for longitudinal research into industrial organisation, employment relationships, and workforce restructuring in the two German federal states. The dataset links establishment survey information with individual employment histories. Its 1993–2000 establishment selection period is particularly relevant for studying organisational and employment changes during the 1990s. Researchers can investigate employee mobility, employment stability, wage structures, and establishment-level characteristics. The linked establishment sample is selective, and access to detailed regional information is restricted.

returned_title: IAB Employee Sample 1975–1997: Regional File
justification: A historical employment dataset archived by GESIS that explicitly covers the 1990s and includes business and industrial management and organisation among its subject classifications. It contains employment information reported by companies to German social security institutions. Its regional component makes it relevant for examining workforce structures, industrial employment, and employment relationships in Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia. The dataset covers 1975–1997, allowing comparisons of regional industrial employment patterns during much of the 1990s. It is particularly suitable for studying the employment side of industrial organisation rather than internal management practices.

returned_title: IAB Establishment Panel, 1993–2018
justification: An earlier documented version of the IAB Establishment Panel that includes the entire 1993–1999 period. It provides establishment-level information on employment, business investment, personnel policies, vocational training, wages, and working arrangements. The dataset is suitable for historical comparisons of industrial management and organisational practices between Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia. It may also be useful for reproducing research conducted using earlier versions of the establishment panel. This is an alternative version of the same underlying survey rather than an independent data collection.

returned_title: Linked Employer-Employee Data of the IAB (LIAB), Cross-Sectional Model 2, 1993–2019
justification: A historical version of the linked employer-employee dataset covering the complete 1990s period from 1993 onward. It integrates establishment survey responses with employee-level administrative records, making it suitable for studying the connections between organisational characteristics and workforce outcomes. Potential applications include comparisons of industrial employment structures, personnel management, occupational composition, and wage patterns between Rhineland-Palatinate and North Rhine-Westphalia. The dataset is particularly useful for research requiring both establishment-level and employee-level observations.

returned_title: German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Cumulation 1980–2014
justification: One of the most comprehensive sources for studying social behaviour and attitudes in Germany during the 1990s. Includes surveys conducted in 1990, 1991, 1992, 1994, 1996, and 1998. Covers political attitudes, social inequality, religion, family relationships, immigration, trust in institutions, economic perceptions, and social participation. Particularly valuable for examining changes following German reunification and comparing East and West Germany.

returned_title: European Values Study (EVS) 1990 – Integrated Dataset
justification: Provides survey data on social, cultural, religious, moral, and political values in Germany in 1990. Includes questions about family, work, religion, social trust, tolerance, political participation, and attitudes toward social institutions. The German sample covers West Germany before reunification. Useful for establishing a baseline of German social attitudes at the beginning of the decade and comparing them with other European countries.

returned_title: European Values Study (EVS) 1999 – Germany
justification: A nationally focused dataset examining German social attitudes and values in 1999. Covers family relationships, gender roles, religion, employment, political preferences, interpersonal trust, tolerance toward minorities and immigrants, civic participation, and life satisfaction. Particularly useful for studying social change during the decade following reunification and comparing attitudes with the 1990 European Values Study.

returned_title: German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP-Core) – Data 1984–2020
justification: A longitudinal household panel survey that includes annual observations throughout the 1990s. Covers household composition, family relationships, employment, education, income, health, subjective well-being, and social and economic attitudes. Its longitudinal design enables researchers to examine how individuals' circumstances and attitudes changed over time. Particularly valuable for investigating social mobility, inequality, and differences between East and West Germany following reunification.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS) – Time-Series Dataset 1981–2022
justification: An international survey dataset incorporating waves from 1990–1992 and 1995–1998. Covers social values, political beliefs, religion, interpersonal trust, gender attitudes, family values, tolerance, and civic engagement. German observations can be selected where available. Useful for examining social and cultural attitudes in Germany within an international comparative framework and exploring value changes during the 1990s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Religion Cumulation 1991, 1998, 2008, 2018
justification: Combines international survey data on religion and related social attitudes, including German observations from 1991 and 1998. Examines religious beliefs, religious practices, attitudes toward religious institutions, and the relationship between religion and society. Particularly useful for investigating secularization and religious differences between East and West Germany during the 1990s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Social Inequality Cumulation 1987, 1992, 1999, 2009, 2019
justification: Provides internationally comparable survey data on public perceptions of social inequality and economic justice. Includes survey waves from 1992 and 1999, allowing investigation of German attitudes toward income differences, social mobility, class structures, economic opportunities, and government redistribution. Particularly relevant for studying perceptions of inequality during Germany's economic and social transformation following reunification.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Family and Changing Gender Roles Cumulation 1988, 1994, 2002, 2012, 2022
justification: Contains comparative survey data on family structures, gender expectations, marriage, employment, and household responsibilities. The 1994 wave is particularly relevant for investigating attitudes toward women's employment, traditional family roles, and the division of domestic labour in 1990s Germany. The longitudinal compilation also allows comparisons between the 1990s and subsequent decades.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Work Orientations Cumulation 1989, 1997, 2005, 2015
justification: Provides survey data on work-related values and employment attitudes across multiple countries, including Germany. The 1997 wave is especially useful for studying job satisfaction, employment preferences, perceptions of job security, work-life priorities, and attitudes toward working conditions during the 1990s. Supports comparative analysis of German workplace attitudes and longer-term changes.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – National Identity Cumulation 1995, 2003, 2013
justification: Contains survey measures of national identity, patriotism, national pride, and attitudes toward immigration and international relations. The 1995 wave offers a valuable opportunity to examine German national identity and social attitudes during the period immediately following reunification. It is particularly relevant for investigating belonging, nationalism, and public perceptions of foreigners.

returned_title: European Values Study – Trend File 1981–2017
justification: A harmonized longitudinal dataset combining multiple European Values Study waves, including 1990 and 1999. Contains comparable indicators relating to religion, family, work, political values, social trust, civic engagement, tolerance, and personal well-being. Especially useful for analyzing changes in German social attitudes between the beginning and end of the 1990s while controlling for longer-term European trends.

returned_title: German Federal Election Studies – Historical Election Survey Data
justification: A collection of representative surveys examining German electoral behaviour, political preferences, and public attitudes. Includes historical studies associated with federal elections in 1990, 1994, and 1998. Relevant variables include party identification, voting behaviour, political trust, evaluations of government, and political participation. Particularly useful for investigating political and social attitudes in reunified Germany throughout the 1990s.

returned_title: Politbarometer – German Political Opinion Survey Series
justification: A recurring German public opinion survey series covering political attitudes and electoral preferences, with historical data available for the 1990s. Includes information on political trust, party preferences, government evaluations, and perceptions of political and social issues. Particularly valuable for tracking short-term fluctuations in public opinion during reunification, economic restructuring, and political change.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Eastern Europe and Germany 1995–1997
justification: A comparative survey dataset specifically covering Germany and Eastern European countries during 1995–1997. Includes measures of political values, social attitudes, family expectations, and individual beliefs. Particularly relevant for comparing German social values with those of societies undergoing political and economic transitions during the post-Cold War period.

returned_title: European Election Study 1994
justification: Provides survey data collected around the 1994 European Parliament elections, including German respondents. Covers electoral participation, political preferences, European integration, and attitudes toward political institutions. The dataset is useful for understanding German political behaviour, European identity, and changing public attitudes toward European integration during the 1990s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Role of Government Cumulation 1985, 1990, 1996, 2006, 2016
justification: Contains survey data on public expectations of government and attitudes toward state intervention, public spending, welfare provision, and political responsibilities. The 1990 and 1996 waves provide opportunities to examine changing German attitudes toward government during reunification and its aftermath. Particularly useful for studying welfare-state preferences, economic policy attitudes, and perceptions of government responsibility.

returned_title: ACLED – Political Violence, Protests and Conflict Events in Germany (2020s)
justification: The Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED) provides georeferenced event-level data on political violence, demonstrations, riots, and other disorder in Germany. Records include event dates, locations, actors, event types, and reported fatalities. Coverage includes the 2020s, making this dataset particularly useful for analyzing political conflict, protest movements, extremist violence, and domestic security trends.

returned_title: ACLED – Conflict and Protest Event Data Download
justification: Provides downloadable conflict and protest event data that can be filtered for Germany and the period 2020 onward. Researchers can investigate the geographic distribution, frequency, and characteristics of political violence and demonstrations. Particularly useful for spatial analysis, time-series research, and comparisons between German regions.

returned_title: German Federal Criminal Police Office – Police Crime Statistics (Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik)

returned_title: German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) – Expenditure, Revenue and Financial Balance of Public Budgets
justification: Official German statistical resource covering public budget revenue, expenditure and financial balances. Provides access to information about government finances at different administrative levels, including federal, state and municipal budgets. Particularly relevant for analyzing public expenditure trends, fiscal decentralization and budget deficits in Germany during the 2020s.

returned_title: Eurostat – Quarterly Financial Accounts for General Government
justification: Provides quarterly financial accounts for government, including financial assets, liabilities, financial transactions and government financial positions. Covers Germany throughout the 2020s, with observations extending into 2026. Useful for examining government financing, debt accumulation, changes in public sector financial assets and the financial implications of fiscal policy.

returned_title: Eurostat – General Government Expenditure by Function: Social Protection, Health and Education
justification: A focused dataset reporting government expenditure on social protection, healthcare and education as a percentage of GDP. Includes annual observations for Germany from 2020 to 2025. Particularly useful for examining welfare spending, social policy priorities and changes in the allocation of public resources following the COVID-19 pandemic.

returned_title: Eurostat – Total General Government Expenditure
justification: Provides standardized government expenditure indicators suitable for comparing Germany with other European countries. Particularly useful for analyzing changes in the overall scale of public spending relative to economic activity during the 2020s. Supports research into fiscal expansion, expenditure restraint and cross-country differences in government economic intervention.

returned_title: OECD – OECD Data Explorer
justification: Official OECD statistical platform providing access to internationally comparable economic and public finance datasets. Researchers can locate indicators covering government revenue, taxation, public expenditure, fiscal balances and debt for Germany during the 2020s. Particularly useful for comparative research evaluating Germany's economic and fiscal policies relative to other OECD economies. This is a dataset discovery platform rather than an individual dataset.

returned_title: Germany Foreign Trade Statistics – Exports and Imports by Country and Commodity (2008–2025)
justification: Official dataset from the German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) containing annual exports and imports by trading partner and commodity classification. Covers 2020–2025, making it particularly useful for analyzing Germany's international trade patterns, trade relationships, export competitiveness, and changes in merchandise trade during the 2020s.

returned_title: Destatis – German Foreign Trade Statistics
justification: Official German statistical data portal providing monthly and annual foreign trade figures, including exports, imports, trade balances, major trading partners, and traded goods. Provides access to data from the 2020s and links to detailed GENESIS-Online datasets. Useful for studying Germany's trade performance, supply chains, and international market integration.

returned_title: Eurostat – Enterprises by Detailed Economic Activity (Structural Business Statistics, 2021–2024)
justification: Official Eurostat dataset covering enterprise characteristics across manufacturing, construction, wholesale and retail trade, and market services. Includes Germany and other European countries for 2021–2024. Useful for examining industrial structure, business performance, sectoral economic activity, and changes in Germany's business landscape.

returned_title: Eurostat – Enterprise Statistics by Size Class and Economic Activity (2021 Onwards)
justification: Eurostat structural business statistics dataset covering enterprises by employment size class and economic activity, with data for Germany during 2021–2024. Particularly valuable for analyzing small and medium-sized enterprises, large industrial companies, market concentration, employment distribution, and differences in business structure across industries.

returned_title: Eurostat – Structural Business Statistics Database
justification: Comprehensive official European statistical database describing the structure and economic performance of businesses. Includes German manufacturing, mining, construction, trade, and services during the 2020s. Relevant indicators include enterprise counts, employment, turnover, value added, and business investment. Suitable for research on industrial competitiveness, productivity, and sectoral transformation.

returned_title: Deutsche Bundesbank – Financial Markets and Macroeconomic Time Series
justification: Official German central bank statistical database containing downloadable financial and macroeconomic time series. Provides data relevant to interest rates, financial markets, securities, banking, monetary conditions, and other economic indicators throughout the 2020s. Useful for investigating German capital markets, financing conditions, monetary developments, and financial stability. Data can be downloaded in CSV and SDMX formats.

returned_title: German Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative – Foreign Trade by Sector and Raw Material (2018–2025)
justification: Official German extractive-sector data portal providing downloadable foreign trade datasets covering 2018–2025, including trade by industrial sector and raw material category. Contains information relevant to coal, crude oil, natural gas, ores, and other mineral resources. Particularly useful for studying Germany's industrial supply chains, raw material dependency, energy-related imports and exports, and changes in commodity markets during the 2020s.

returned_title: Destatis – International Foreign Trade Indicators
justification: Official Destatis statistical resource providing internationally comparable foreign trade indicators and access to detailed trade statistics. Includes information relevant to Germany's position in global merchandise trade during the 2020s. Useful for comparing German export and import performance with other countries and analyzing changes in international market shares and trade relationships.

returned_title: Eurostat – Short-Term Business Statistics
justification: European statistical data resource covering short-term developments in industry, construction, retail trade, and market services. Provides indicators suitable for tracking industrial production, turnover, and market activity in Germany throughout the 2020s. Particularly relevant for studying the effects of COVID-19, energy price shocks, industrial restructuring, and changes in consumer demand.

returned_title: Destatis – German Foreign Trade Statistics (German-Language Data Portal)
justification: German-language official statistical portal providing detailed information and access to datasets on Germany's international merchandise trade. Includes monthly and annual trade indicators, historical series, commodity-level information, and links to GENESIS-Online statistical tables. Useful for researching German industrial exports, import dependency, trade balances, and international market developments during the 2020s.

returned_title: IAB Establishment Panel (IAB-Betriebspanel), 1993–2024
justification: One of Germany's most comprehensive longitudinal datasets on business management, organisational structures and employment practices. Conducted annually by the Institute for Employment Research (IAB), it includes observations from 2020–2024. Variables cover personnel management, recruitment, workforce development, employee training, investment, innovation, working arrangements and business performance. Particularly relevant for studying organisational change, human resource management and industrial management in Germany during the 2020s. Research access is restricted.

returned_title: Mannheim Innovation Panel (MIP) – Innovation Activities of German Enterprises
justification: An annual representative enterprise survey conducted by the ZEW Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research. It provides firm-level information on innovation management, organisational innovation, technological development, research and development expenditure, digital transformation and business strategies. The panel includes observations from the 2020s and covers manufacturing and service industries. Particularly valuable for analysing how German businesses organise and manage innovation. Microdata access is available to researchers under specific conditions.

returned_title: Mannheim Enterprise Panel (MUP) – German Firm-Level Business Dynamics
justification: A comprehensive longitudinal database covering more than nine million German companies. It contains information on company formation, closure, employment, turnover, industry classification, legal structure, ownership and financial characteristics. Its coverage extends into the 2020s, making it suitable for studying organisational development, corporate restructuring, entrepreneurship, industrial dynamics and business growth. Firm-level datasets and indicators are available through ZEW, with access conditions and potential fees.

returned_title: German Federal Statistical Office – Enterprise Births and Deaths by Industry and Employment Size
justification: An official German enterprise demography dataset covering 2018–2024. It provides annual information on enterprise creation and closure, business survival dynamics, employment and enterprise size across economic sectors. Particularly relevant for examining organisational restructuring, industrial entrepreneurship, market entry and exit, and structural changes in German business activity during the 2020s. The statistical tables are publicly accessible and downloadable.

returned_title: Destatis GENESIS-Online – Structural Business Statistics by Enterprise Size and Economic Activity
justification: An official statistical dataset covering 2008–2024, including the 2020s. It provides detailed information on enterprises, employment, turnover, investment, gross value added, personnel expenditure, wages and operating performance. Data can be disaggregated by enterprise size and economic sector. Especially useful for researching industrial organisation, business productivity, resource allocation, enterprise performance and structural differences between German industries. Data are publicly available.

returned_title: KfW SME Panel – German Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise Management
justification: An annual representative survey of German small and medium-sized enterprises, with editions covering 2020–2025. It examines business performance, investment decisions, financing structures, innovation, digitalisation and enterprise development. The dataset is particularly useful for analysing strategic management, financial management, organisational adaptation and business resilience among German SMEs during the 2020s. Public reports provide aggregated statistical findings, while underlying microdata are not openly downloadable.
